import pandas as pd

# Dataframe
def test_dataframe_dot_operation():
    cols = ["a", "b"]
    df_a = pd.DataFrame(
        [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]], columns=cols, dtype="float[pyarrow]"
    )
    df_b = pd.DataFrame([[1, 0], [0, 1]], index=cols, dtype="float[pyarrow]")
    df_c = df_a.dot(df_b)

    print("input")
    print(df_a.dtypes)
    print(df_b.dtypes)
    print("output")
    print(df_c.dtypes)

# Series
def test_series_dot_operation():
    cols = ["a", "b"]
    s_a = pd.Series([1, 2], index=cols, dtype="float[pyarrow]")
    df_a = pd.DataFrame(
        [[1, 2], [3, 4], [5, 6]], columns=cols, dtype="float[pyarrow]"
    )
    s_b = df_a.dot(s_a)

    print("input")
    print(s_a.dtypes)
    print("output")
    print(s_b.dtypes)

def main():
    print("--- Testing DataFrame Dot Operation ---")
    test_dataframe_dot_operation()
    print("--- Testing Series Dot Operation ---")
    test_series_dot_operation()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
